_scenario: TC-RECON-PIPE-004 -- the LIVE geneva pipeline e41a47ba-5ad0-4dc5-9535-5aa16cc97e65 ([dev arjun] Metaflow_test_104_reconcilation_batch), moved from job-mode reconciliation to in-pipeline reconciliation.
_provenance: Every id, table name, match key and compare column below was read back verbatim from metaflow.config.* on 2026-08-31 (dataflow_group_spec / ingestion_flow_spec / reconciliation_flow_spec for dataflow_group_id dfg_geneva_tariffs_recon). The dataflow_id and reconciliation_id therefore MATCH the rows already onboarded, so re-onboarding this spec MERGEs those rows in place rather than adding a second ingestion flow and a second reconciliation flow alongside them. Do not rename either id without understanding that consequence.
_why_audit_only: execution_mode is 'pipeline_audit_only', NOT 'pipeline'. The reconciliation source (metaflow.geneva_admin.stg_tariffelementband) is this same group's own ingestion target, written with cdc_load_strategy TRUNCATE_AND_LOAD -- a full recompute that REPLACES the table every update, not an append. Delta refuses to stream from such a table (DELTA_SOURCE_TABLE_IGNORE_CHANGES), and 'pipeline' mode requests a streaming read of the recon source, so the source plane's G-STREAM guard rejects it at plan time. 'pipeline_audit_only' reads the source as a batch instead: the L3 prepare and L4 compare datasets (classified / metrics / mismatch) are registered INSIDE this pipeline's own DAG -- which is what makes reconciliation finally visible in the Lakeflow graph -- while the L5 heal lane (the append back into landing_tariffelementband) stays in job mode.
_difference_from_051: metaflow_testing/051_geneva_tariffs_recon.json declares the same dataflow_group_id but a DIFFERENT ingestion flow (df_geneva_tariffs_near_ingest -> tariffelementband_near) and a different reconciliation_id. It is a synthetic mirror of this shape, not this pipeline's actual configuration; onboarding it would add flows to this group rather than update the existing ones. This file is the one that corresponds to the deployed pipeline.
